entities.summary: Annie Laurie was an American jump blues and rhythm and blues singer. She is most associated with the bandleader and songwriter, Paul Gayten, although she also registered hit singles in her own name. Laurie first recorded in the mid-1940s and her professional career lasted until the early 1960s. Appraisal of her qualities appear to vary between Dinah Washington stating that Laurie was her favorite singer, to Irma Thomas, who opined – "Annie Laurie? She was okay.". Annie Laurie was a composers & musicians from Atlanta (1924-08-11, Atlanta–2006-11-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
